rules.R001: Verified primary test prediction and new frozen-policy episode: prioritize human assessment
rules.R002: Verified primary score at threshold but episode suppressed: review existing alert, no new alert
rules.R003: Verified visible error records in bounded window: review those records
rules.R004: Verified visible maintenance records in bounded window: inspect recorded history
rules.R005: Verified visible prior failure records in bounded window: review recorded history without diagnosis
rules.R006: Verified exact-key historical sensor context: compare historical trends
rules.R007: Any unavailable component: request source-data verification, abstain from unsupported specifics
